title: Concentration and Total RNA Extraction of Viruses from Nasal Swabs
author: Vanessa Smilansky
materials: Gather the materials and reagents for the QIAamp® Viral RNA Mini Kit in a biosafety cabinet. Equilibrate samples to room temperature. Add 25 mL of 100% ETOH to Buffer AW1. Add 30 mL of 100% ETOH to Buffer AW2. Check Buffer AVL for precipitate, and if necessary incubate at 80 °C until the precipitate is dissolved. It is not necessary to add carrier RNA. Refer to the "Guidelines" section for instructions on processing and handling RNA samples.

Gather the materials and reagents for the QIAamp® Viral RNA Mini Kit in a biosafety cabinet. Equilibrate samples to room temperature. Add 25 mL of 100% ETOH to Buffer AW1. Add 30 mL of 100% ETOH to Buffer AW2. Check Buffer AVL for precipitate, and if necessary incubate at 80 °C until the precipitate is dissolved. It is not necessary to add carrier RNA. Refer to the "Guidelines" section for instructions on processing and handling RNA samples.

steps.title: Prepare vacuum filtration apparatuses
steps.instruction: In the fume hood, set up two separate 0.45 µm vacuum filtration units, each attached to a clean 100 mL Pyrex bottle.

steps.title: Distribute nasal swabs into tubes
steps.instruction: In a biosafety cabinet, remove nasal swabs (n ≥ 25) from secondary containers and place them evenly into Falcon 50 mL conical centrifuge tubes, ensuring no tube receives more than 20 swabs.

steps.title: Transfer liquid to clean tubes
steps.instruction: Excluding the negative control, pour the liquid from each swab‑containing tube into a clean centrifuge tube, leaving the swabs behind; cap, parafilm, and place each new tube in a secondary container, aiming for a final volume of 10–20 mL per tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge samples and settle aerosols
steps.instruction: Move all tubes (including the negative control) to a centrifuge with the appropriate rotor (e.g., Beckman Coulter Avanti J series with JA‑14.50 rotor) and spin at 1200 × g, 4 °C for 10 min. After the run, wait 00:10:00 for aerosols to settle before opening the rotor, then place tubes in a secondary container and transfer them to the fume hood.

steps.title: Decant supernatant onto filtration tops
steps.instruction: Decant the supernatant from each tube directly onto a 0.45 µm vacuum filtration top, taking care not to disturb any pellet. For the negative control (which has no pellet), decant directly onto its filtration top.

steps.title: Perform vacuum filtration
steps.instruction: Cap the vacuum filtration top, open the vacuum line, and filter the supernatant until complete; then cap the Pyrex bottle and set it aside. Filtration time will vary with supernatant consistency.

steps.title: Add HBSS to each tube
steps.instruction: Using a 50 mL serological pipette, add 1 mL of HBSS per swab to each tube (including a clean tube for the negative control); cap and parafilm each tube.

steps.title: Vortex tubes
steps.instruction: Place all tubes on a vortexer with a 50 mL tube adapter and vortex at 1000 rpm for 00:00:30 (30 seconds).

steps.title: Start-up InnovaPrep Concentrating Pipette
steps.instruction: Turn on the InnovaPrep Concentrating Pipette Select, navigate to Maintenance → Start‑up, follow the prompts, verify the maintenance tip is installed, position the waste line, remove the storage‑fluid line and insert the foam elution canister, and confirm the screen reads “ULTRA”.

steps.title: Concentrate nasal swab filtrate
steps.instruction: Remove the maintenance tip and install a fresh Ultra CPT tip; lower the tip into the sample bottle (as close to the bottom as possible, balancing the bottle on its edge if needed with a weighted HBSS bottle). Press “Start Run” and wait for the beep indicating completion. Hold a 5 mL Eppendorf tube under the tip, press “Elute”, and collect the foam eluate (~600 µL). Transfer the 600 µL eluate to a 5 mL Eppendorf tube; about 1 mL of unconcentrated filtrate remains in the Pyrex bottle.

steps.title: Concentrate negative control filtrate
steps.instruction: Run the concentration protocol on the filtered negative control in the same manner, using a fresh tip and collecting a 600 µL unconcentrated aliquot.

steps.title: Shut down InnovaPrep device
steps.instruction: Navigate to Maintenance → Shut Down, place the maintenance tip back into the tip port, remove the elution canister, verify adequate storage fluid and re‑insert the storage‑fluid line, turn off the device, and remove the waste line.

steps.title: Add Buffer AVL and incubate
steps.instruction: To each of the four 5 mL tubes (concentrated sample, concentrated control, unconcentrated sample, unconcentrated control) add 2.4 mL Buffer AVL (4× volume), pulse‑vortex for 00:00:15, incubate at room temperature for 00:10:00, then spin down.

steps.title: Add ethanol and mix
steps.instruction: Add 2.4 mL 100 % ethanol to each tube, pulse‑vortex for 00:00:15, and spin down.

steps.title: Add Buffer AW1 and spin
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW1 to each tube, centrifuge at 6000 × g, °C, for 1 minute, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Load onto spin columns and spin
steps.instruction: For each sample and control, transfer 700 µL to a designated spin‑column tube, centrifuge at 6000 × g, °C, for 2 minutes, and discard the flow‑through. Repeat this transfer‑centrifuge cycle up to 8 times or until the entire volume has passed through the column. Then move the spin‑columns to clean collection tubes.

steps.title: Add Buffer AW2 and final spin
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW2 to each spin‑column, centrifuge at 6000 × g, °C, for 3 minutes, transfer the columns to clean collection tubes, then centrifuge at maximum rpm, °C, for 1 minute to remove residual buffer, and finally transfer the columns to designated 1.5 mL Eppendorf tubes.

steps.title: Elute RNA and store
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL nuclease‑free water (NFW) to each spin‑column, incubate at room temperature for 00:02:00, centrifuge at 6000 × g, °C, for 1 minute to collect the eluate, discard the columns, and store eluates at –80 °C. Note: DNase treatment of the eluate is required to remove co‑precipitated DNA.
